description:
Take a peek behind the AANHPI Heritage Month Doodle and see how K-pop dance crew @SHEROFFICIALS adapted the official @LESSERAFIM_official “Celebration” choreo for the #GoogleDoodle video  🎬💃🕺 

From the dance floor to the animation studio, here’s how we transformed every move into digital magic.

Track and official choreography: “Celebration” by @LESSERAFIM_official
title: Behind the Doodle: The Art of K-Pop Dance #GoogleDoodle

description: In celebration of Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander Heritage Month, this Doodle celebrates the art of K-Pop dance by shining a light on the American K-Pop dance community—where global fandoms connect through local artistry. The Doodle is set to @LESSERAFIM_official's song “Celebration” with choreography interpreted by LA-based K-Pop dance team @SHEROFFICIALS.
title: The Art of K-Pop Dance #GoogleDoodle
